payload.title: Still to come: the meeting where the consultation results are due
payload.summary: The Licensing committee is due to meet on 17 September 2026, and the council has said the responses will come back to it in a report. On 7 September 2026 the meeting page showed no documents at all. Until the papers appear, nobody outside the council knows what the responses said or what officers will recommend.
detail: Agendas at Norwich are usually published about five working days ahead, so papers would be expected around 9 or 10 September 2026.
Officers told the March committee that agreement would be sought at this meeting to recommend the policy to full council.
